setup: Lie on your back, knees bent
Working foot flat, under the knee
Lift the other knee toward your chest
execution: Press through the heel of the working foot
Raise your hips until they're level
Keep both hips the same height

notes: Holding the free knee to your chest keeps the lower back from arching.
If the back of the thigh cramps, move the working foot a little closer to your hips.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Lying on the back, near foot flat with the knee bent, hips on the floor. Far knee drawn toward the chest. Arms on the floor by the sides.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Hips raised so the body is straight from shoulders to the near knee. Hips level. Far knee still drawn up.

ikHints: Shoulders and near foot fixed on the floor
emphasise: Hips rise level, no dropping on the free side
Straight line from shoulders to knee at the top
